name: keel-spring
description: Generador Spring Boot para diseños Keel: valida el diseño agnóstico y genera services/<servicio>-spring/ con el scaffolding transversal al stack más el conocimiento del agente; los adaptadores de infraestructura y la lógica de negocio los completa el agente con /keel-generate-spring dentro del proyecto.

scripts.compile-check: node scripts/compile-check.js && node scripts/compile-check.js asset-vault --broker=snssqs && node scripts/compile-check.js asset-vault --broker=kafka --auth=cognito && node scripts/compile-check.js notification-mailer --broker=snssqs && node scripts/compile-check.js job-dispatch && node scripts/compile-check.js job-dispatch-mongo --broker=kafka && node scripts/compile-check.js stock-reservation --broker=kafka && node scripts/compile-check.js notification-mailer-mongo --broker=kafka && node scripts/compile-check.js payout-runs && node scripts/compile-check.js job-dispatch --database=oracle
scripts.claim-check: node scripts/claim-check.js && node scripts/claim-check.js job-dispatch --database=mysql && node scripts/claim-check.js job-dispatch --database=mariadb && node scripts/claim-check.js job-dispatch-mongo && node scripts/claim-check.js notification-mailer && node scripts/claim-check.js notification-mailer-mongo
scripts.store-check: node scripts/store-check.js notification-mailer && node scripts/store-check.js notification-mailer --database=mysql && node scripts/store-check.js notification-mailer-mongo && node scripts/store-check.js stock-reservation && node scripts/store-check.js stock-reservation --database=mysql && node scripts/store-check.js asset-vault

author: asuridev
